sentences.text: Radhika Agarwal vs Piyush Garg on 20 February, 2023

Bench: A.S. Bopanna, Hima Kohli
 1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Civil Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition(s)(Civil) No(s). 1217-1219/20
Radhika Agarwal Etc.

Petiti
 Versus
 Piyush Garg Respon
 O R D E R
1. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the petition papers.

2. In the instant transfer petitions, the matter was earlier referred to the Supreme Court Mediation Centre through the Order dated 11.11.2022 to explore settlement of the matrimonial disputes between the parties.
3. In the process of mediation, the parties have arrived at a settlement which is reduced into an agreement dated 09.02.2023.

Through the said settlement agreement, it is agreed that the petitioner-wife would receive a sum of Rs. 21 lakhs from the respondent-husband, and in that view of the matter, the remaining litigation between the parties would be brought to an end and the marital relationship between the parties, having irretrievably broken down, the parties agree that this Court exercise its powers under Article 142 of the Constitution of India and dissolve the marriage between the parties which was solemnized on 22.11.2019.
The Settlement Agreement dated 09.02.2023 arrived at between the parties, is taken on record and is made a part of this Order.

4. The petitioner-wife is before this Court and the amount agreed to in terms of the settlement agreement has now been paid through a demand draft which was handed over to the petitioner-wife in Court.
5. In that view of the matter, the proceedings which had been initiated by the parties against each other before different Courts also are required to be closed/quashed.
6. Accordingly, the below mentioned criminal proceedings stand quashed;
